draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Sringeri! Adi Shankara set up his first peetham here on the Tunga River in the 8th century, and the Sharadamba Temple is still at its heart.
draft.hungryLine: The Sringeri Mutt serves good food at noon and at night, and there are small budget messes along the temple street.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Sri Sharadamba Temple is about a 19 min walk. Right next to it on the riverbank is the Vidyashankar Temple, built in old Hoysala style.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Cross the footbridge to Narasimha Vana, the ashram on the other side of the river. It's a peaceful place for a quiet stroll.
moodReplies.surprise-me: During the Third Anglo-Mysore War in 1791, the Sharadamba Temple was attacked by Pindaris, and Tipu Sultan wrote to the Shankaracharya offering money and gifts to restore it.

legends.title: The cobra and the frog
legends.body: When Adi Shankara came here in heavy rain, he saw a cobra spread its hood over a struggling frog to shelter it instead of eating it. Moved, he prayed to the Goddess and set up the temple on that spot.

tips.title: Dress right for the shrines.
tips.body: Men need a dhoti and women a saree or salwar kameez with a shawl, and trousers or jeans aren't allowed into the main shrines.

tips.title: Eat at the Mutt.
tips.body: The Sringeri Mutt serves good, clean meals at noon and at night.

story.title: Shankara's first peetham
story.body: Adi Shankara set up the Sharadamba Temple and his first monastery here, the southern one of his four cardinal peethams.

story.title: The Vidyashankar Temple
story.body: On the river bank next to the Sharada temple, the Vidyashankar Temple was built in old Hoysala style.

story.title: Raided and restored
story.body: Pindaris attacked the temple during the Third Anglo-Mysore War. Tipu Sultan sent letters of sympathy and offered protection, money and gifts to restore it.

story.title: A living seat
story.body: The present Jagadguru lives at Narasimha Vana across the river, and the peetham still runs a Sanskrit school on the southern bank.

food.name: Sringeri Mutt
food.detail: Good, clean meals at noon and night
